commit_chain_strategy: The commit_chain records the complete branch history from first commit to final branch head (901da33). No self-referential SHA — the final commit cannot record its own hash. The merge readiness report is always regenerated at the current HEAD before merge, so any stale commit in the committed report is superseded by the live gate run.
